description: Every refusal of authorize and token (I-08, WIRE-CONTRACT-V4 §12.4, §12.5). A wrong client_id or an unlisted redirect URI renders a card page and never a redirect. Plain PKCE, an openid scope and a missing state redirect to the registered URI with error, state (when sent) and the issuer. At token a verifier that is not the code's ends the code: invalid_grant, and the right verifier no longer works. Cancel on the card redirects with access_denied. The Worker refuses a JSON body, a repeated parameter and other grants as well (worker tests); an SDK cannot be made to send them.

steps.note: A client_id that is not the product: the card renders invalid_client and nothing redirects.
